title: Cursor pagination
description: Cursor-based page envelope shared by every collection response: 'items' plus 'nextCursor' (null on the last page). Requests use 'cursor' (opaque, from the previous page) and 'limit' (page size). There are no unbounded collections: every list is paged or naturally bounded.
$comment: Source: DISENO 3.8.5 (cursor + limit <= N_pagemax on every collection without a natural bound); PRD RF-033, RF-034 (stable order, merge per shard), RF-120, RNF-042, RNF-003. Audience: all. Residency: a cursor issued by a cell is only valid in that cell.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page; clients must not parse it (S3: encodes the position per shard, RF-034).

limit.description: Requested page size: 1 .. N_pagemax (named parameter, DISENO 0.2 and 3.8.5); a larger value gets 400 invalid-request.

nextCursor.description: Cursor of the next page; null when there are no more items.
